target.title: Config hot-reload re-resolution loses ChatGPT-OAuth (codex) routing for gpt-5.6-sol; boot-time resolution is correct (2026.7.1-beta.2)
target.body:
**Environment:** OpenClaw 2026.7.1-beta.2, macOS (LaunchAgent gateway),
model openai/gpt-5.6-sol served via ChatGPT OAuth profile; manual
models.providers.openai entry coexisting with the native catalog.

**Summary:** Boot-time resolution auto-enables the codex runtime and
routes gpt-5.6-sol to api=openai-chatgpt-responses at
https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/responses (policy=custom). ANY
config hot-reload — including keys unrelated to models — triggers a
model re-resolution that loses this routing. Every fresh-resolution
turn then fails until a full gateway restart. In-flight/cached sessions
keep working, which masks the outage (probe replies succeed on cached
routing while scheduled/new turns fail).

**Repro (one machine, config byte-identical at start and end):**
1. Hot-reload of agents.defaults.heartbeat.every (unrelated key) ->
   all subsequent fresh resolutions fail pre-fetch in ~30-70ms:
   "Auth profile uses oauth auth, but resolution requires an OpenAI
   API key profile". 36 consecutive scheduled turns failed; fallback
   models failed identically. Restart fully restores.
2. Added models.providers.openai.api="openai-chatgpt-responses" (hot
   reload): fresh resolution now POSTs the OAuth token to
   https://api.openai.com/v1/responses -> 401 "Missing scopes:
   api.responses.write". Note: variant 1 fails closed pre-network;
   variant 2 transmits the OAuth token to the wrong endpoint.
3. Added baseUrl="https://chatgpt.com/backend-api" as well: fresh
   resolution hits …/backend-api/responses (missing the /codex path
   segment the healthy boot path uses) -> 403.
4. Reverted both keys + restart: healthy (verified: full scheduled
   turn, 11/11 fetches status=200 on …/backend-api/codex/responses).

**Expected:** hot-reload re-resolution preserves (or re-runs) the
boot-time codex auto-enable for OAuth-gated models, or skips
re-resolving models whose configuration did not change.

**Workaround adopted:** restart the gateway after every config change
while serving gpt-5.6-sol.
